notes.note: Round 5: traced all six setup POST handlers plus existing GET/DELETE resource counterparts. Integration writes persist config; reconnect probes MCP discovery and configuration reload; tools/apply and enabled persist policy/state then reload. Skill create/delete writes owned package files, Agent CRUD writes definitions with deferred activation, and catalog reads do not submit turns. Recorded exact methods/paths and source lines; setup remains authenticated and may launch MCP processes. Added setupApi with the existing transport signature, strict audited allowlist, relative-path/encoding checks and no turn reservation. Billable api now reserves all non-exempt POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests. reservedBillableRequests is separate from sentTurns (known turn/steer submission attempts), and both render distinctly; no provider-completion claim. Dated version suffixes require Bedrock vendor-dot identity as undated ones do. 279 focused tests across four files and 131 matrix cases pass. After clean commits, allowing continuation through setup failed a real-route assertion because its promise resolved; removing the suffix guard failed four alias assertions; both exact restorations passed 131. Setup side effects are stubbed with real POST schemas in the seam test; actual configuration activation/MCP startup and live providers remain NOT_VERIFIED. All existing scenario/context members remain compatible, including lazy sessionId and method forwarding.
